issues: ValueError: Supported responses must not contain issues

findings: The search used latest=True rather than the explicitly requested fiscal_year=2026. It selected FY2026 in this snapshot, but this is not a robust implementation of a fixed-year request.
The specialist retrieved one broad excerpt, then the complete Item 1A section (114842 characters) for a targeted one-risk question.

The reconstructed initial Writer prompt contains 123917 characters versus 26654 in English. Configured num_ctx is 16384 tokens; character counts are not token counts. Actual truncation is unconfirmed because prompt-evaluation telemetry is not recorded.

Both Writer drafts were English despite the Turkish question. The first draft also falsely described the inventory-related charge as a charge imposed by the US government; the local report describes an expense NVIDIA incurred due to excess inventory and purchase obligations.

The second draft expanded beyond the requested export risk and attached every narrative citation to Source 1, a broad regulatory excerpt that does not support all of the detailed competition, litigation and governance claims. Source 2 contains the full section but was not cited for those claims.
Critic returned all approval flags true, incorrectly including language_matches=true, with a nonempty issues list praising the answer and mentioning details absent from the final draft.
Verdict consistency validation rejected the all-true/nonempty-issues response. No answer was released, but this was a format consistency rejection, not successful semantic or language detection.

conclusion: Neither run delivered an answer. Evidence retrieval succeeded but different retrieval strategies and input sizes confound an isolated translation comparison. Writer/verification reliability and bounded context need attention before broad quality claims.
limitations: Two development cases, one execution each; not a general language/model benchmark.
No causal proof that input length caused language drift or the malformed verdict.
No exact input/output token telemetry was captured.
Local source verification only, not an external SEC audit.
next_step: Run a controlled bilingual Writer/Critic comparison with identical bounded evidence to separate retrieval strategy from language behavior.
Use that evidence to design a bounded context policy and targeted-query behavior without removing the full-section tool.
Improve diagnostic recording of incomplete model responses before blindly increasing output limits.
